items.title: Configure domain routing for partner DBAs
items.description: Set up Vercel path-based routing (or separate projects) so each future DBA/app can live under www.clevelsalesguy.com (e.g., /d2c, /bespoke, /enterprise).

items.title: Provision analytics properties per DBA
items.description: Create GA4 (or Segment) properties for each DBA category and document the env vars needed for per-app tracking.

items.title: Design DBA metrics view for Software Factory admin
items.description: Create UI designs and component specifications for the DBA dashboard metrics view. Include KPI cards, charts, filtering, and drill-down views for financial, hosting, and analytics data.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard mockups for overview and detail views
Component specifications for KPI cards and charts
Responsive design for desktop and tablet

items.title: Implement API endpoints to serve per-DBA analytics
items.description: Build Next.js API routes to aggregate and serve financial (Stripe), hosting (Vercel), and analytics (GA4) data for each DBA. Include caching, error handling, and role-based access control.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/admin/dbas - List all DBAs with summary metrics
GET /api/admin/metrics/:dbaId - Fetch aggregated metrics for specific DBA
Error handling and retry logic for external APIs
